title: Grok image-generation misuse and regional responses
summary: Image-editing features on Grok, built into X, were used from late December 2025 to create non-consensual sexualised edits of real people, including minors. Governments across the region took different actions within about three weeks.
caution: The onset date is the start of a documented analysis window of mass misuse; sources differ on the exact start, so day counts are approximate.
regional_note: No ASEAN-level action specific to Grok was found in the sources checked. The Hanoi Digital Declaration (16 Jan 2026) holds general AI-safety commitments, not a response to this event.
